evidence.label: 整体退款率对比
evidence.sql:
SELECT 
        b.end_date AS current_end, DATE(b.end_date, '-29 days') AS current_start,
        DATE(b.end_date, '-59 days') AS previous_start, DATE(b.end_date, '-30 days') AS previous_end,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date >= DATE(b.end_date, '-29 days') THEN o.order_id END) AS current_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date >= DATE(b.end_date, '-29 days') AND o.is_refund = '是' THEN o.order_id END) AS current_refunds,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date < DATE(b.end_date, '-29 days') THEN o.order_id END) AS previous_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date < DATE(b.end_date, '-29 days') AND o.is_refund = '是' THEN o.order_id END) AS previous_refunds
        FROM orders AS o CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS end_date FROM orders) AS b
        WHERE o.order_date >= DATE(b.end_date, '-59 days') AND o.order_date <= b.end_date
        GROUP BY b.end_date ORDER BY current_refunds DESC LIMIT 50
